answer: A fraud-bounty network can choke Sybil swarms: any agent may file a signed fraud report, and independent investigators verify it. If proven, the reporter earns a bounty funded by the offender's slashed bond, while false reporters lose their own stake. Like a whisper carried across a dune field, one credible report reaches every counterparty before the fake can trade again, so each fake identity risks exposure from many directions. Honest agents keep an ivory-clean record; attackers pay, per identity, for the chance of being caught.
